description: This Java source file defines the ImageUtils class, providing utility methods for image processing tasks such as rotation, scaling, cropping, retina support, and icon loading within the Android Studio rendering tools.

classes.name: ImageUtils
classes.description: A utility class for various image processing operations in Android Studio rendering.

methods.name: rotateByRightAngle
methods.description: Rotates a BufferedImage by a multiple of 90 degrees.

methods.name: isRetinaImage
methods.description: Checks if a BufferedImage is a Retina (high DPI) image.

methods.name: supportsRetina
methods.description: Indicates if Retina images are supported.

methods.name: convertToRetina
methods.description: Converts a BufferedImage to a Retina image if possible.

methods.name: drawDipImage
methods.description: Draws an image with support for high DPI scaling.

methods.name: addMargin
methods.description: Adds transparent margin around an image.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales an image with various options for size and margins.

methods.name: cropBlank
methods.description: Crops transparent pixels from the edges of an image.

methods.name: getCropBounds
methods.description: Calculates the crop bounds for an image based on a crop filter.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops an image according to a crop filter and initial crop rectangle.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads a built-in icon from the Android plugin resources.
